title: ETL Pattern — Pipeline, Watermarks, SQL and Airflow DAG
title_es: Patrón ETL — Pipeline, Watermarks, SQL y DAG de Airflow
description: Runnable ETL pipeline: extract to staging, transform, delete+insert load, incremental watermarks, pure-SQL variant (PostgreSQL 15+ MERGE), Airflow DAG, SQLite demo and pytest suite.
description_es: Pipeline ETL ejecutable: extracción a staging, transformación, carga delete+insert, watermarks incrementales, variante en SQL puro (MERGE de PostgreSQL 15+), DAG de Airflow, demo en SQLite y suite pytest.
